queries: Kambhampati o1 PlanBench evaluation (direct arXiv lookup 2409.13373)

sources_considered.why: Primary source abstract: 'LLMs Still Can't Plan; Can LRMs?'
Full text has the problem-size results.

receipt.public_excerpt: Without any obfuscation, we see performance quickly degrade from the 97.8% reported earlier. In fact, over these 110 instances, o1-preview only manages 23.63%, and most of this accuracy comes from correctly solving problems which require fewer than 28 steps.

evidence_items.explanation: o1-preview scored 97.8% on small problems but 23.63% on 6-20 block problems, and its correct answers on the larger set were mostly the shorter plans. That is good performance on small problems with a quick fall-off.

receipt.public_excerpt: while o1's performance is a quantum improvement on the benchmark, outpacing the competition, it is still far from saturating it.

evidence_items.explanation: The authors also call o1 a large improvement over earlier models. This is fair context: 'ok on small problems' if anything undersells the 97.8%.

unresolved_gaps: Only o1-preview was tested; later o1 versions are not covered by this analysis.
